authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9875.3 *marucca explicitly gives Awan maruc pepper. Survey Awan maroc chili selects this u-vowel branch, with o retained; the broader pepper name has been transferred to chili as attested elsewhere in this article. Exact survey form maroc is preserved.
